name: pl-generate_hdf5
title: A training data set generation app
description: An app to convert original and segmented brain images in mgz format to .hdf5 format in axial, sagittal, and coronal plane

parameters.name: dataset_name
parameters.help: path and name of hdf5-dataset (default: testsuite_2.hdf5)

parameters.name: plane
parameters.help: Which plane to put into file (axial (default), coronal or sagittal)

parameters.name: slice_thickness
parameters.help: Number of pre- and succeeding slices (default: 3)

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.help: Pattern to match files in directory.

parameters.name: image_name
parameters.help: Default name of original images. FreeSurfer orig.mgz is default (mri/orig.mgz)

parameters.name: gt_name
parameters.help: Default name for ground truth segmentations. Default: mri/aparc.DKTatlas+aseg.mgz. If Corpus Callosum segmentation is already removed, do not set gt_nocc. (e.g. for our internal training set mri/aparc.DKTatlas+aseg.filled.mgz exists already and should be used here instead of mri/aparc.DKTatlas+aseg.mgz).
